meta.title: Community Board · Dushanbe's notice board
meta.description: Pin a slip for a lost wallet, a tutor or a room near campus. Dushanbe's notice board, in Tajik, Russian and English.

about.heroText: Pin a slip for a lost wallet, a tutor before exams, or a room near campus. People tear off a tab and write to you on Telegram.
about.heroNote: Free. Тоҷикӣ · Русский · English. Works on any phone.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Text: Category, a clear title, photos, district, and price. One minute.
how.step2Text: They browse the board by category, district, and price.
how.step3Text: They write on Telegram or call. When it’s done, you stamp it resolved.

safe.title: Safe and fair
safe.checkedText: Anyone can report a slip. Admins remove spam and scams.
safe.studentText: Confirm your university email to get the student badge.
safe.daysText: Slips come down after 30 days, so the board stays fresh.

rules.title: House rules
rules.item1: Be honest: real items, real prices, real photos.
rules.item2: One slip per item or offer.
rules.item3: Pick the right category and district.
rules.item5: Be kind in comments and messages.
rules.item6: Stamp it resolved when it’s done.

auth.loginSub: Log in to see what’s pinned near you.
auth.registerSub: Free, and it takes a minute.
auth.dialogLabel: Log in or create an account
